howto.name: Paste JSON or XML
howto.text: Or upload a file. Auto-detects format from braces / tags.

howto.name: Click Format
howto.text: Adds indentation, proper line breaks, sorted keys (optional). Removes extra whitespace.

faq.a: Yes — invalid JSON / XML shows an error with the line and column. Common errors (trailing commas, unclosed strings, mismatched tags) are highlighted.
This tool only formats. For conversion, paste into the CSV/JSON converter or use a dedicated converter.
